Din Djarin rescues him and takes him in as a foundling. He trains briefly with Luke Skywalker, then chooses the Mandalorian path and becomes Din's son and apprentice.

name: Moff Gideon
affiliation: Galactic Empire (Imperial Security Bureau) → Imperial Remnant (Shadow Council)
summary: An Imperial Security Bureau officer who takes part in the Great Purge of Mandalore and tricks Bo-Katan out of the Darksaber, Gideon outlives the Empire as a remnant warlord. He hunts Grogu for blood to feed his cloning work, loses the child and the blade to Din Djarin, escapes Republic custody, and dies when the Mandalorians retake their homeworld.

summary: A disgraced former magistrate turned Guild agent, Karga hands Din Djarin the job that leads him to Grogu, then heads the hunters sent to take the child back. Healed by Grogu after a night attack, he fights beside Din to free Nevarro from Gideon's remnant, and as its magistrate turns the planet into a thriving independent trade port.

summary: An Alderaanian who was offworld when the Death Star destroyed her home, Cara joins the rebels as a shock trooper and hunts warlords after Endor, then resigns when reassigned to escort and riot duty. A mercenary on Sorgan, she helps Din Djarin defend a village and free Nevarro, becomes the planet's marshal, and later joins New Republic Special Forces.

summary: Duchess Satine's sister, Bo-Katan fights for Death Watch until Maul kills its leader and seizes Mandalore, then turns on him and helps the Republic drive him out. She briefly rules as regent, rallies the clans against the Empire with the Darksaber, and loses it to Gideon in the Great Purge. Years later she unites the Mandalorians and retakes their homeworld.

summary: A top assassin for the Hutts and other syndicates, Fennec begins by hunting the clone girl Omega against Cad Bane. With her employers jailed after the Empire's fall, she hides on Tatooine until Din Djarin and Toro Calican catch her and Calican shoots her. Boba Fett saves her with cybernetics, and she becomes his partner and enforcer.

summary: A Chiss officer adopted by the Mitth family, Thrawn defends the Ascendancy against the Grysks, then is exiled and joins the Empire to study it. Rising to Grand Admiral, he hunts the Lothal rebels with the Seventh Fleet until purrgil drag his flagship and Ezra Bridger to Peridea. A decade later he escapes to lead the Empire's remnants.

name: Hera Syndulla

summary: A Twi'lek from war-torn Ryloth, Hera flies the Ghost and builds her own rebel cell, the Spectres, with Kanan Jarrus. She rises to lead Phoenix Squadron, helps free Lothal from Thrawn after Kanan's death and bears their son, Jacen. A general through Endor and the New Republic years, she later backs Ahsoka's hunt for Thrawn and Ezra.

He trains Ezra Bridger, defeats the Grand Inquisitor, is blinded by Maul on Malachor, and dies on Lothal shielding Hera and his friends from a blast.

He wrestles with the dark side after Malachor, clashes with Thrawn, and frees Lothal by vanishing into hyperspace with Thrawn's flagship. Stranded on Peridea, he returns a decade later.

She wields the Darksaber to unite the clans, hands it to Bo-Katan, and helps free Lothal. After training under Ahsoka, she follows the search for Ezra to Peridea.

Cranky and mischievous but loyal, he fights through the Lothal insurgency, helps find the rebels a base on Atollon, and stays at Hera's side into the New Republic years.

As Axis he plans the Aldhani heist, recruits Cassian Andor, and sacrifices allies to protect his sources. Cornered by the ISB, he tries to take his own life, and Kleya finishes it.

name: Mon Mothma
affiliation: Galactic Republic (Senate) → Galactic Empire (Imperial Senate) → Alliance to Restore the Republic (Chancellor) → New Republic (Chancellor)
summary: Elected Chandrila's senator at sixteen, Mothma argues for peace through the Clone Wars and stays in the Imperial Senate while secretly bankrolling Luthen Rael's rebel network. After the Ghorman massacre she denounces the Emperor, flees, and leads the unified Rebel Alliance as its chancellor. After Endor she becomes the New Republic's first Chancellor and cuts back its military.
